headline: Europe's first case: Ebola detected for first time in Europe
summary: A rare and deadly virus has been identified in the European region, marking a significant health alert for the continent.
details: The European region has reported its first-ever case of Ebola virus disease, sparking immediate health alerts across the continent.
Ebola is a severe, often fatal illness in humans, characterized by high fever, internal bleeding, and organ failure.
Health authorities are now working to monitor potential contacts and implement strict containment measures to prevent further spread.
This development marks a first for Europe, prompting international health organizations to heighten their surveillance of travelers and incoming passengers.

headline_marked: 101 million Europeans [[face deadly heatwave]] with temperatures over 35C
headline: 101 million Europeans face deadly heatwave with temperatures over 35C
summary: Extreme temperatures hit France, Spain, and Italy, causing deaths and forcing France to shut down nuclear reactors as a precaution.
details: Over 101 million people in Europe are expected to experience temperatures exceeding 35C in a heatwave described as hotter than parts of Africa.
France and Spain have been among the worst-hit countries, with reports of deaths, including children, as the extreme heat persists.
In Italy, five people have died and red alerts have been issued for 17 cities to manage the crisis.
France has taken the drastic step of shutting down nuclear reactors as a precautionary measure against the extreme heat.
According to AFP calculations based on German weather service forecasts, more than 380 million people across the continent are facing temperatures over 30C.
